question: Can B0, BR and BS be built with exact marker-count parity and comparable genetic-map coverage before any local-ancestry model is run?
later_estimand: Paired difference in LAI error between BR and BS, where both arms add the same number of markers to the identical B0 baseline.

pool_access.rule: Marker selection must be recomputed from the tree sequence using only FREQ and REF_LAI nodes. The M28 rare catalog is diagnostic evidence, not a selector input.

rare_selector.minor_allele_policy: min(AC, AN-AC) computed from genotypes; never assume ALT is minor

nonrare_screens.interpretation: Exact non-rare complement of the frozen rare threshold; primary capacity screen.

nonrare_reference_rule: The FREQ-oriented minor allele and its complement must both occur at least once in pooled REF_LAI.

b0_mapping.template_coordinate: Interpolate template bp through the authenticated genetic map; ignore VCF INFO/CM.
b0_mapping.candidate_order: Map sorted template positions without replacement to the nearest eligible simulated marker while preserving genomic order; break ties by absolute cM distance, absolute bp distance and site id.
b0_mapping.rationale: The maximum is no wider than the finest preregistered BS matching stratum; p95 is five times tighter. Both are checked before LAI.

bs_matching.selection_rule: Within each fixed map bin, select without replacement from eligible non-rare markers not used by B0, pairing sorted rare and control markers deterministically.
bs_matching.primary_width_rule: Use the narrowest preregistered width that achieves exact global and per-bin cardinality for the primary non-rare screen and primary REF threshold.
bs_matching.physical_distance: Report bp distances as a diagnostic; cM remains primary.

arms.BR: Identical B0 plus all rare markers passing the primary REF_LAI observability rule.
arms.BS: Identical B0 plus exactly the same number of reserved non-rare markers as BR, matched in cM.

gates.C0_INPUT_IDENTITY: All authenticated input hashes, template counts and map bounds match exactly.
gates.C1_ACCESS_BOUNDARY: Only FREQ and REF_LAI nodes are loaded for marker statistics; the command interface has no TARGET, DONOR, mosaic or truth input.
gates.C2_RARE_DEFINITION: Rare MAC, MAF and minor orientation exactly reproduce the frozen M28 definition.
gates.C3_B0_MAPPING: B0 has 110074 unique markers, preserves order and passes the preregistered cM displacement limits.
gates.C4_ARM_PARITY: B0 is identical in all arms and the BR and BS additions have exactly equal global and per-bin cardinality without overlap or replacement.
gates.C5_ANCESTRY_SUPPORT: The primary BR additions retain at least one REF_LAI-supported marker in AFR, EUR and ASIA; ASIA remains labelled ASIA.
gates.C6_REPRODUCIBILITY: Repeated execution yields byte-identical public summaries and marker manifests.
gates.C7_SCOPE: No LAI model, TARGET genotype, truth metric, accuracy or boundary score is computed.

stop_rule: Any failed gate stops before LAI. Do not reduce BR, relax rare thresholds, widen beyond 1.0 cM, replace the baseline template or choose a screen using LAI performance. A design change requires a new preregistration version.
development_seed_policy: Seed 20260817 may be used only for this technical capacity audit and remains excluded from later DEV and TEST effect estimation.
